findings: The symmetric hard-wall Hamiltonian, fixed physical delta strength, origin-pinned defect, canonical preparation and right-wall force readout determine a unique apparatus. The support and detector definitions give no virial correction or numerical method.

The starter computes the complete even/odd delta-box spectrum and canonical populations correctly. Its 2 times mean energy divided by length is the scale-free cavity relation; a fixed delta coupling introduces a separate length scale. This is a physical stress-attribution error, not a spectral or algebraic bug.

For even wavefunctions proportional to sin(k(L/2-abs(x))), normalization is L/2-sin(kL)/(2k), and the boundary stress is k squared divided by twice mass times that normalization. The odd modes have zero defect amplitude and the scale-free force.

Equivalently each state contributes (2E-g times its probability density at the defect)/L. At Gibbs equilibrium the average is minus the fixed-g derivative of free energy; this confirms the force on either symmetric wall.

The independent reference discretizes the full interval Hamiltonian with a central g/dx potential and extracts boundary derivative stress from normalized eigenvectors. Two-grid Richardson extrapolation and thermodynamic displacement checks support the exact-root oracle.
